d:
Official music video for "Made in the Stars | Shubha Mangalyam" by Vidya Vox.
Hi everyone! it's been a while, but I'm back! This is the first of many videos planned for the summer :) I had the opportunity to work with Kerala Tourism on this beautiful video, shot in the beautiful God's Own Country! Enjoy :)
